name: Jetcar
short_description: An Indonesian-developed marine vehicle concept designed for recreational and tourism applications.
description:
Jetcar is an Indonesian-developed marine vehicle concept designed for recreational and tourism applications.
The concept targets resorts, marine tourism operators and experience providers looking for distinctive water-based attractions. House of Nusantara routes qualified business inquiries directly to the producer.
Detailed technical data is shared by the producer during the inquiry process.
